title: Must-know glossary (interview flashcards)
disclaimer: Short definitions for verbal practice. Teaching models in this repo are not production silicon or plant software.

cards.def: When the metric happened vs when the collector received it. Rates and watermarks use event/observation time.
No trustworthy sample. Never coerce to 0 for means, trips, or BER.
tc/netem and TcpRetransSegs are L3/L4. Lane BER/SNR/eye are physical-layer. Keep them separate.
FEC coding gain lowers residual uncorrectables; it does not turn optical errors into TCP drops.
Composite of SNR/BER/eye/jitter/flaps for triage. Teaching weights ≠ Credo product FOM.
Raw append → cleansed/conformed (SCD2) → curated aggregates for consumers.
Join facts to the dimension version valid at event_time, not is_current only.
Apply changes by change/sequence time, not feed arrival order.
Null keys, duplicate ids, illegal types fail visibly. Silent drops are a smell.
(experiment_id, user_id) must be unique in silver enrollment or causal analysis is garbage.
Observed cell shares must match the designed split before trusting lifts.
Peak allocate→arrive lag past SLO fails health even if uniqueness is clean.
Zero-filling coolant temperature is a safety data bug. Trips only on status=ok.
Declare primary metric before comparing. A/A must not alarm; deliberate regressions must.
